messages:
maya: Quick sync — product approved adding a 'streaming_minute' meter for live sessions. This touches metering, billing, quotas, and contracts. Need clear owners and a short plan. Who volunteers?

jonah: I can own metering + SDK. Plan: emit meter 'stream_min_v1' per-minute with session_id, customer_id, stream_type. Add 'legacy_meter' for overlap. ETA 7 business days incl tests. I'll open WIP PR.

samir: Billing: need canonical meter name, unit=minute, hourly rollups, and overlap/backfill approach. Prefer overlap where both meters increment and we dedupe. Also need sample payload and SQL.

lina: Legal: enterprise contracts protected. Can't change semantics without notice. Need amendment template, preserve legacy quota semantics until opt-in or 30d after notice, and audit log. Will draft with inputs from eng.

maya: Proposed owners: metering=@jonah, billing=@samir, contracts=@lina. Product will handle comms + rollout. Milestones: metering PR +3d, billing mapping +5d, contract draft +5d, canary +10d, public rollout +14d. Call out blockers.

jonah: Emitted event will look like:
```
{"meter":"stream_min_v1","unit":"minute","value":1,"session_id":"sess_ABC","customer_id":"acct_987","stream_type":"voice","legacy_meter":"streaming_minutes"}
```
I'll add `preserve_legacy_quota` boolean for protected accounts and a `--simulate-overlap` QA mode.

samir: OK. For billing we'll provide mapping and dedupe SQL. Prefer no retro invoice edits; overlap then dedupe. Also confirm proration policy — do we prorate mid-cycle when quota changes?

lina: Recommend: notice + no automatic prorations unless customer agrees. I'll include language. Also request an export of affected customers before rollout.

maya: Action items: jonah add flag + export; samir draft mapping + SQL; lina draft amendment + comms; product to prepare notice timeline. ops-bot reminder: pricing sync Tue 10:00am PT.

jonah: Will open PR WIP at https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/XXXX. Will add integration tests for quota transition.

samir: I'll post sample SQL in a short design doc and tag this thread. ETA 5d.

lina: Drafting amendment and customer email, ETA 5d. Will coordinate with product comms.

maya: Thanks — I'll update the project board and send out the calendar invite for the rollout check. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
